claims: Arizona State University is a public research university.
Arizona State University has an ~90% acceptance rate.
Tuition at Arizona State University is approximately $34,175 for in-state students and $55,091 for out-of-state students.
Arizona State University is consistently ranked as the #1 most innovative university in the U.S. by U.S. News & World Report.
ASU has an acceptance rate of around 89.9%, as noted by PrepScholar.
Applications to ASU generally require high school transcripts.
SAT/ACT scores are encouraged but not always mandatory for ASU applications.
The total estimated cost of attendance (sticker price, including tuition, housing, and fees) at ASU is approximately $34,175 for in-state residents and $55,091 for out-of-state residents.
ASU's key campuses include Tempe, Downtown Phoenix, Polytechnic, and West Valley.
ASU Online offers online master’s degrees often priced between $18,000 and $30,000.
